headline: Economic activity likely fell in September; expected to grow 0.2% in October: IOAE
summary: The IOAE indicator suggests Mexico's economy lost momentum in the third quarter of 2026. It estimates activity fell in September and rose 0.2% in October.
why: The IOAE is a timely monthly estimate of Mexican economic activity, used by investors to gauge the economy before official GDP data.
original_headline: Actividad económica habría caído en septiembre; en octubre habría crecido 0.2%: IOAE
